message.content:
The image is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. The cover is divided into two sections by a jagged, white, paper-like tear across the top third.

The top section has a yellow background. It features a stylized, orange-skinned man with short red hair and a sweating forehead. He wears a grey uniform with gold stars on the collar. A black and grey clapperboard partially obscures him on the left. White text reads: "BUKTI BARU PEMBUNUHAN BRIGADIR YOSUA H.114".

The lower section depicts a large, detailed illustration of an older man’s face. He has dark hair, many wrinkles, and wide, light-colored eyes. A bright horizontal beam of light shines across his eyes. He wears a dark, patterned garment. To the right, white text states: "EDISI KHUSUS HARI KEMERDEKAAN HITAM-PUTIH ALI SADIKIN Gubernur Jakarta yang Melampaui Zaman. H.64".

Small text includes dates "15-21 AGUSTUS 2022," price "RP 50.000," website details, a barcode, and a QR code.
